about:
Slowhouse Furniture & Design operates from Thompsonville, Michigan. The company was founded by Brad, who works directly with clients on commissioned pieces; no founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces a line of original furniture including the Verglo platform bed, Allen credenza, Mooney console table, and Lasso coffee table, alongside fully custom commissions such as dining tables and desks. Production details, facility size, and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

Slowhouse serves both residential and commercial customers, with testimonials referencing custom console tables, dining tables, and office desks. The company emphasizes a collaborative design process, translating client visions into finished pieces for homes and commercial spaces.

The business highlights a relational approach, stating it listens closely to client needs while applying professional experience. A noted initiative is that each product sold contributes to a tree-planting program.
